fact: Hgraam is the leader of the Stone Giant clan.
source_quote: Hgraam spoke gravely of his apprentice, the Stone Giant
subject: Hgraam

fact: Hgraam's apprentice was a Stone Giant who was driven to madness by the stones themselves.
source_quote: The apprentice had been driven to madness not by any enemy blade, but by the very stones themselves.
subject: Hgraam's apprentice

fact: Hgraam expresses grief over his apprentice's condition.
source_quote: Hgraam expresses grief over his apprentice, who was driven mad by the stones
subject: Hgraam's grief

fact: Hgraam warns that something ancient and terrible is stirring in the blackest depths of the Underdark.
source_quote: He warned that something ancient and terrible was stirring in the blackest depths of the Underdark
subject: Hgraam's warning

fact: Hgraam recites omens including a cave with two faces, rock devoured, land overgrown, and a pebble that believes itself flesh.
source_quote: He recited a list of omens: a cave with two faces, rock devoured, land overgrown, a pebble that believes itself flesh.
subject: Omens recited

fact: Hgraam calls the surface world the Dreamlands, describing it as foreign and possibly mythical.
source_quote: He called the surface the Dreamlands, a place so foreign to him it might as well be myth.
subject: Dreamlands

fact: The party has never been to the surface and Hgraam considers it nonexistent.
source_quote: He has never been to the surface, and for him it doesn't exist.
subject: Dreamlands

fact: Hgraam does not know the way to the surface.
source_quote: He does not know the path himself.
subject: Hgraam

fact: Hgraam states that the deep gnomes know the way out to the surface.
source_quote: He has only heard through trade that the deep gnomes know a way out.
subject: Deep Gnomes

fact: Jimjar previously told the party that the best path back to the surface runs through the town of the deep gnomes.
source_quote: Jimjar had told them the same, though Jimjar may have had other agendas
subject: Jimjar

fact: Hgraam describes the Whorlstone Tunnels as filled with evil.
source_quote: There is much evil in there.
subject: Whorlstone Tunnels

fact: Hgraam explains that the Deepking's attempts to enforce control cause evil to escape the city and seize control of it.
source_quote: The more he enforces control, the more it escapes outside the city to seize control of the city.
subject: Deepking's control

fact: Daz finds the giant's speech regarding the tunnels comical and senseless.
source_quote: Daz finds the giant's speech comical and senseless ("This makes absolutely no sense")
subject: Daz's observation

fact: Invisible duergar patrol the city above, forcing factions to hide underground.
source_quote: away from the invisible duergar patrolling the city above.
subject: Duvderpatrols

fact: The party has encountered a creature of Demogorgon's power.
source_quote: demons they have already encountered: - Demogorgon
subject: Demogorgon

fact: The party has encountered the creation worshipped by the kuo-toa.
source_quote: the kuo-toa's worshipped creation
subject: kuo-toa creation

fact: The party has encountered demonic manta rays in the water.
source_quote: demonic manta rays in the water
subject: demonic manta rays

fact: The party saw demons fighting among themselves during the escape from Velkynvelve.
source_quote: demons fighting among themselves during the escape from Velkynvelve
subject: brawling demons

fact: Zalthir deduces that the increasing presence of demons is tied to the apprentice's madness.
source_quote: Zalthir's Arcana check led him to suspect that the apprentice's madness was tied to the growing presence of demons.
subject: Zalthir's deduction

fact: The demonic presence is far more widespread than the party's previous sightings suggested.
source_quote: That presence was far more widespread than the party's scattered sightings of Demogorgon, the creation the kuo-toa worshipped, the demonic manta rays and the brawling demons at Velkynvelve had suggested.
subject: Scope of demonic threat

fact: The Deepking was once a measured and reasonable leader.
source_quote: The ruler of Gracklstugh had once been a measured and reasonable leader
subject: Deepking

fact: The Deepking has grown paranoid, erratic, and increasingly isolated from his oldest allies.
source_quote: but in recent times had grown paranoid, erratic, and increasingly isolated from his oldest allies.
subject: Deepking

fact: Shal is a new favored advisor to the Deepking.
source_quote: The change, Hgraam believed, had begun when a new favored advisor named Shal had wormed his way into the king's confidence.
subject: Shal

fact: Shal has never come to visit the Stone Giant clan leader.
source_quote: Even the Stone Giant clan leader had never been permitted to meet this advisor.
subject: Shal

fact: The Deepking has asked Hgraam about the Gray Ghosts.
source_quote: The Deepking had asked Hgraam about the Gray Ghosts
subject: Gray Ghosts

fact: Hgraam knows nothing about the Gray Ghosts.
source_quote: but Hgraam knew nothing of them.
subject: Hgraam

fact: Hgraam advised the Deepking to be patient and watch the stones.
source_quote: He has advised the Deepking to be patient and "watch the stones."
subject: Hgraam's advice

fact: Hgraam ends the audience stating that there are rocks that need to be tended.
source_quote: it is time for you to leave there are rocks that need to be tended.
subject: Audience ended

fact: Hgraam presents the party with a polished crystal as a token of gratitude.
source_quote: The Stone Giant leader presents the party with a polished crystal as a token of gratitude
subject: polished crystal

fact: Hgraam's apprentice brings out the polished crystal.
source_quote: His apprentice brings it out.
subject: gift presentation

fact: Gyrgum is struck by how different Hgraam is from other giants he knew who mostly bellowed and hit things.
source_quote: Gyrgum is struck by how different this giant is from the ones he knew, who mostly bellowed and hit things
subject: Gyrgum
